description: Web3 UI component library from Hyperweb (formerly Cosmology). Distributed as @interchain-ui/react, @interchain-ui/vue, etc. Built on BuilderIO mitosis for cross-framework compilation. Provides cross-chain wallet connectors, chain pickers, asset displays, NFT views, governance UI, and token swap primitives across Cosmos, EVM, Solana, and 200+ chains. Pairs naturally with Mzizi: both use MCP for discovery, both prioritise developer experience over chain-specific protocols.
name: Interchain UI (Hyperweb / Cosmology)
